metric_scope: Original-total geometry/UV/counts and rendered geometry silhouettes are measured, not artistic similarity. Visor coverage is amber pixels divided by the isolated full head's projected front silhouette, not total 3D surface area. Original body, limbs and skin binds remain exact.
residuals: A short visible neck seal may remain; sampled family coverage does not prove zero exposed cloth or zero clipping at every animation time/view.
The original neck interface alone does not certify visual fit. This revision separately measures occluded visible-neck pixels.
Actual user art acceptance, browser interaction, mobile performance and exported product smoke remain NOT RUN.

visor_coverage_summary.definition: Visible amber glass pixels divided by the whole ArmorHead_05 mesh front orthographic white silhouette interior; all other meshes, background and antialias edges excluded. Any neck geometry contained in ArmorHead_05 remains in the denominator. Not UV area, total 3D surface area, roundness or artistic likeness.
visor_coverage_summary.classification: mask RGB channels >=224; amber r>g>b, r-g>=7, g-b>=9, r-b>=35; fixed for selected amber/steel-blue palette

editor_import_log_limitations: Editor import exits successfully but emits the existing audio-missing-archive-tfpon_0v directory warning; the transient import helper also logs editor shutdown RID cleanup warnings. These are not counted as a clean editor log.

neck_mix_summary.scope: Source-interface and sampled-animation checks, separate from visible-neck style coverage.

original_neck_interface.scope: Original neck position/UV/topology/named-skin interface only; rendered mixed-body coverage is a separate requirement
original_neck_interface.discovery: true-original position-welded triangle components with active named head and torso/neck bones

shell_fit_geometry_revision.scope: Explicit shell down-fit and lower-frame extension only; rendered mixed-body neck coverage is verified separately

visual_inspection.scope: Root directly inspected six selected final native-material images: front/quarter camera reproductions, low-collar body28 quarter, rear body0, reload quarter and actual level01 gameplay. This is selected-image inspection, not a claim of reviewing every frame or browser interaction.
observations: Original tall black neck column is covered in inspected front/quarter views. Short rear cloth seal remains.
Round amber visor is retained. Existing blue jaw/frame becomes deeper to cover low collars; its thickness remains subject to user art review.
Reload weapon can visually occlude the chin in normal gameplay; the separate final diagnostic explicitly hides all weapons and still passes all348 samples.
